parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

>  You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~196830~~) operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs.

parameters.name: ServiceSpec
parameters.description:
The specifications of the service. Unit: capacity units (CUs). Valid values:

*   2
*   4
*   8
*   16

example.unifiedCli: aliyun gpdb modify-streaming-data-service --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-bp10g78o9807yv9h3 --service-spec 2 --service-id 1 --service-description test-adbpgss --region cn-hangzhou
